1.t: When the heaven is split asunder

2.t: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

3.t: And when the earth is spread out

4.t: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

5.t: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

6.t: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

7.t: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

8.t: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

9.t: And will return unto his folk in joy.

10.t: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

12.t: And be thrown to scorching fire.

13.t: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

14.t: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

15.t: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

16.t: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

17.t: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

18.t: And by the moon when she is at the full,

19.t: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

20.t: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

21.t: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?

22.t: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

23.t: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

24.t: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

25.t: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
